components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creation even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the last name and a global owner sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' from the customer code and the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of owners that already shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) when it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

## What I changed

The E.164 telephone flows through validation on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` (bean validation on the request DTO is what produces the `400` here — an entity-level constraint would instead throw at persist and map to `500`). The repo already has a precedent for custom DTO field validators wired through the OpenAPI spec (`PetAgeValidation` via `x-field-extra-annotation`), so I followed that exact idiom:

1. **`E164NationalLength.java`** — a new field constraint annotation (mirrors `PetAgeValidation`).
2. **`E164NationalLengthValidator.java`** — a small `ConstraintValidator<E164NationalLength, String>`. It normalises the raw input with the existing `PhoneNumbers.toE164`, then checks national-digit count against a `Map.of("+61", 9, "+1", 10)`. Blank input and unknown country codes pass through (so `@NotEmpty`/`@Pattern` and other countries keep their existing behaviour).
3. **`openapi.yml`** — added one line, `x-field-extra-annotation: "@...E164NationalLength"`, on the `telephone` field so the generator stamps the annotation onto the DTOs.

## Why this keeps structural impact low

- **No existing method was modified** — `Owner`, `PhoneNumbers`, the controllers, and the exception advice are all untouched, so the large-class `WMC_other` multiplier is never paid.
- The new logic lives in one small, single-method validator class (its `WMC_other` is 0), and `PhoneNumbers.toE164` is **reused** rather than duplicated.
- The only edit to an existing file is a single additive YAML line — no function bodies changed.

## Verification

- Full suite: `BUILD SUCCESS`, `AcceptanceTest.errorRejectsWrongNationalLength` passes.
- Confirmed the annotation is emitted into both generated DTOs, and directly probed the validator across cases the old regex can't catch — e.g. `+6112345678` (8 national digits) and `+1608555102` (9 national digits) are now rejected, while `+61412345678`, `+16085551023`, and unknown codes like `+441234567890` pass.
